events.what: Chang and Sun prove Harborth's conjecture for all 4-regular planar graphs (LIPIcs GD 2024)
'On the Harborth Conjecture. Part I' makes progress on Kleber's conjecture (integer vertex coordinates too), proving the non-degenerate-quadrilateral case
Förster, Kobourov, Miller, Zink give polynomial-grid integer-edge drawings of trees and cacti (Kleber-type, already-known class)

judgement.doubts: The Chang–Sun event is dated only '2024'; per the rules a year-only 2024 date cannot be placed relative to 26 January 2024. GD 2024 proceedings make an after-snapshot date likely, but the record never checks for an earlier preprint. If the first written argument came before the snapshot, the status would be open (a pre-snapshot partial result). The record's codes are kept. Peer-reviewed LIPIcs proceedings count as digested, though only a case was settled. The 4-regular case is a restriction (a graph class), so it is scored as a case, not a bound.

corrections.why: F7/other: the event date is year-only '2024' (event.precision 'year') and so cannot be placed either side of 26 Jan 2024. It is kept as after-snapshot on the assumption that the GD 2024 publication is the first written argument. The record shows no earlier preprint, but it also shows no check for one.
